name: pf1-psionics
description: Psionics module for Foundry VTT (PF1 system).

scripts.build:packs: npm run build:powers && npm run build:classes && npm run build:features && npm run build:buffs
scripts.build:features: npx @foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli package pack psionic-class-features --id pf1-psionics --type Module --inputDirectory packs-src/class-features --outputDirectory packs
scripts.build:buffs: npx @foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli package pack psionic-buffs --id pf1-psionics --type Module --inputDirectory packs-src/buffs --outputDirectory packs
scripts.build:powers: npx @foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli package pack psionic-powers --id pf1-psionics --type Module --inputDirectory packs-src/powers --outputDirectory packs
scripts.build:classes: npx @foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli package pack psionic-classes --id pf1-psionics --type Module --inputDirectory packs-src/classes --outputDirectory packs
